subject.title: Feature Request: Add 'description' field to agent config for dynamic agent discovery

question: Should `agents_list` expose bounded operator-authored `agents.list[].description` metadata for agents already visible to the requester?
rationale: Current main accepts the config field, but exposing arbitrary authored metadata to model-visible discovery output establishes a lasting product and security-boundary contract that should be explicit before the linked PR lands.

options.title: Expose bounded descriptions
options.body: Return trimmed, length-bounded descriptions only for agents admitted by the existing `agents_list` authorization path, and land the linked PR with tests and documentation.

options.title: Keep descriptions config-only
options.body: Retain the metadata for configuration and doctor preservation but reject runtime tool exposure, documenting another supported catalog mechanism for orchestrators.

recommendation.title: Expose bounded descriptions
recommendation.body: Return trimmed, length-bounded descriptions only for agents admitted by the existing `agents_list` authorization path, and land the linked PR with tests and documentation.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal covers the original discovery tool, multi-agent routing, and the product boundary being extended.
